title: Inter vs Genoa Without Bastoni? Thigh Scans, No Return Date | Nerazzurri Daily
description:
Inter can beat Genoa tonight without Bastoni — the scans found a sore left thigh and the club gave no return date.

CONFIRMED — Scans on Alessandro Bastoni found soreness in the quadriceps of his left thigh; no return date given (Inter.it, Nov 27).
CONFIRMED — Giovanni Ayroldi referees Inter vs Genoa; Inter are unbeaten in their last 14 Serie A meetings with Genoa (Inter.it, Nov 27).
REPORTED — Carlos Augusto moves into the back three with Dimarco on the left, the setup that finished against Stuttgart (Corriere dello Sport, Nov 27).
NEXT — Inter vs Genoa, Sat, Nov 28, 2:45 PM ET, 20:45 CET, Serie A matchday 13. US TV: Paramount+.
